Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers

Class Controller.ControllerLogs

java.lang.Object
frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers.Controller.ControllerLogs
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.struct.StructSerializable, edu.wpi.first.util.WPISerializable
Enclosing class:
Controller
public static class Controller.ControllerLogs extends Object implements edu.wpi.first.util.struct.StructSerializable
A struct-serializable, loggable snapshot of a Controller's state at one instant - see Controller.getLogs(). Every field mirrors one of the controller's getters.
